data.one_liner: A Dart library that parses CSS strings or byte lists into an AST.
data.what_it_does: It parses CSS source into a structured stylesheet object that can be inspected or debug‑printed. The API is pure Dart and works on all supported platforms.
use_when: You need to analyze or transform CSS in a Dart/Flutter app
You want a lightweight, pure‑Dart way to read CSS files without native dependencies
avoid_when: You need a full CSS rendering engine or layout engine
You require advanced CSS features that are not yet supported
strengths: Supports many CSS units and functions
weaknesses: Only parses, does not render or apply styles
May lag behind the latest CSS specifications

alternatives.name: petitparser
alternatives.why_pick_it: A generic parser combinator library that can be used to build a custom CSS parser if you need more control
